## Goal

One or two sentences. What is true after this task that was not true before.

## Files

Exact paths. Creating a file that is not on this list is a deviation and is
reported, not absorbed.

| Path | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `path/to/file.py` | create \| modify \| delete |

## Acceptance criteria

Observable and checkable. Pass or fail must not be a judgement call.

## Tests

Named test cases that must exist and pass. Not "add tests".

| Test | Asserts |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/.../test_x.py::test_y` | |

## Do not

The specific wrong turns available at this task. This field prevents more
defects than any other, because it names the plausible mistake before it is
made.
